Tooltip_EwingsFoods_CheeseHeat: Requires a nearby lit fire, fireplace or barbecue, or an unbroken stove that is on, powered and warmed. Mains and generator electricity both work.
Tooltip_EwingsFoods_TomatoPaste: Requires 9 whole, fresh, uncooked, thawed tomatoes; an empty pot, sharp knife and stirring utensil (kept); and nearby lit fire or an unbroken, on, powered, warmed stove. Mains and generator power work. Makes vanilla packaged, nonperishable tomato paste; no can or jar is produced.
Tooltip_EwingsFoods_LoadedNachos: Assemble tortilla chips, cheese, tomato, fresh jalapeno and onion on a plate with a sharp knife (kept). No heat required to prepare. Reheat the ready-to-eat dish for 2 less unhappiness while hot; calories stay the same. One plate returns only when the food is depleted.
